caption: The video captures a static close view of a smoldering pile of charred debris, dark matted burnt vegetation mixed with ash and pale fragments. A thick column of white-grey smoke rises and billows from the center and left of the pile, drifting upward. This plume shifts its shape and horizontal spread from frame to frame, thickening and thinning as it climbs. On the right edge of the pile a small open flame burns continuously, its height, width, and outline flickering and deforming. At times the flame splits into two tongues, and at times a brief separate ember appears just above it. The flame's base stays fixed on the right side while only its luminous shape changes. A vertical post stands at the far left, and scattered pipes, wood, and ash sit blurred in the background. The charred pile and these surrounding objects remain in fixed positions throughout the excerpt, with no camera pan or zoom. The only visible motion is the ongoing smoke and flame dynamics of the fire already in progress.
